## Interactive review

A commit of 200 added plus deleted lines or more, or a pull request over 500,
needs the interactive review before it is opened
([how it is counted](https://github.com/sysprog21/codetrial/blob/main/docs/large-change-explanation.md)). The
pre-push hook writes the block below to
`.git/codetrial-review/pr-description.md` when it passes; paste it in place of
this one. A smaller change still carries the block, saying `not required`.
